newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CELTIC KEEP ALIVE SLIM TITLE HOPES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTIC KEEP ALIVE SLIM TITLE HOPES.

text.p: Two goals from Portuguese striker Jorge Cadete and one from Simon Donnelly kept alive Celtic's slim hopes of the Scottish championship as they beat Aberdeen 3-0 on Sunday.
Cadete's first gave Celtic a 1-0 lead at the break before Donnelly's crashing header made the points safe after 51 minutes. Twelve minutes later Cadete added a third.
The win leaves Celtic nine points behind arch-rivals Glasgow Rangers who, with three games remaining, are still clear favourites to clinch a record-equalling ninth successive crown.
